scope: Expert Mission skill acquisition reconciliation for EM16-20
purpose: Bridge the Expert Mission evidence layer to the seeded skills index without overwriting canonical skill records until acquisition and identity evidence are reconciled.

records.mission_title: In the Realm of the Gods: Vegeta
records.evidence: Current Expert Mission indexing and skill references associate Super Spirit Bomb with EM16.

records.mission_title: In the Realm of the Gods: Goku
records.evidence: Current skill documentation identifies Spirit Sword as a Strike Ultimate unlocked through EM17; the current Expert Mission index also lists Spirit Sword for EM17.
records.historical_note: An older guide labels the EM17 reward as Spirit Bomb; this is retained as a historical naming conflict and is not treated as the current canonical identity.

records.evidence: Current skill documentation identifies Focus Flash as a Ki Blast Super obtained from EM18; the current Expert Mission index lists it as the EM18 skill reward.
Current skill documentation identifies Tail Slicer as a Ki Blast Super obtained from EM19; the current Expert Mission index lists it as the EM19 skill reward.
Current skill documentation identifies Data Input as a Power Up Super unlocked through EM20; the current Expert Mission index lists it as the EM20 skill reward.
records.mechanic_note: Current skill documentation reports a 20-second self-buff with automatic evasion behavior while the applicable stationary conditions are met.

cross_domain_rules: Do not treat a mission's listed skill reward as a guaranteed per-clear drop unless evidence establishes the condition.
Do not infer an exact drop percentage from repeated player reports.
Keep raid-related rewards such as Gigantic Ki Blast, Brainwash Attack, and Peeler Storm separate from the ordinary skill acquisition route.
Do not replace the seeded skills index wholesale merely to add acquisition data.
Promote individual skill records only after identity, category, acquisition route, and current-version evidence are reconciled.
